svg.title: The Road to the Sea
svg.desc: The westward road crosses the Far Downs and Tower Hills to Mithlond, at the head of the Gulf of Lhûn. Forlindon is north of the gulf; Harlindon is south. Original regional interpretation; north up; no numerical scale.

g.text: The Shire · Emyn Beraid · the Grey Havens
NORTH UP · REGIONAL SCALE · THIRD AGE
